name: factory-skills
description: NewEcom.AI Factory — free launch skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI.

scripts.validate:plugin: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.claude-plugin/plugin.json','utf8'));if(!m.name||!m.version||!m.author||!m.license)throw new Error('plugin.json missing required field (name/version/author/license)');if(!Array.isArray(m.skills)||m.skills.length!==5)throw new Error('plugin.json must list exactly 5 skills');for(const s of m.skills){if(!fs.existsSync(s))throw new Error('missing skill dir: '+s)}console.log('plugin.json OK:',m.name,m.version,'-',m.skills.length,'skills')"
